architecture: MLP 5f: Linear(5,32), ReLU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(32,32), ReLU, Linear(32,1)
input_processing: Original signed midpoint distance divided by first recorded value; negative distances preserved, no clipping or absolute value; no secondary input scaling
training: Current implementation: shuffle trial order; one Adam step per complete trial; equal trial mean absolute loss; lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.0001
selection: Fixed 400 epochs; last epoch saved; no Test used for fitting, tuning, or epoch selection
window: Five consecutive real inputs oldest-to-current; no initial padding; discard windows across missing/invalid rows or frame/time gaps >0.1s
split: Existing D3 Train / Validation reused as Train / Test; whole trials; no five-fold CV
diagnostic_scope: Legacy signed-distance experiment requested explicitly. No landmark-5 or mm fallback. D3 differs from current recordings in multiple ways; this comparison alone cannot isolate a causal effect of changing the landmark.
